# dotfiles stance registry

The canonical topology is the review graph. Edit the graph, then regenerate.

## Stances

| Stance | Axis | Objective | Accepts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`dotfiles-portability-stance`](../dotfiles-portability-stance/SKILL.md) | portability-vs-live-state | A tracked config renders correctly on every selected machine without a manual rescue. | `dotfiles-live-state-stance` pays: a live value must be carried back into local.toml before it can render |
| [`dotfiles-live-state-stance`](../dotfiles-live-state-stance/SKILL.md) | portability-vs-live-state | A tool's live config survives deploy and is not silently overwritten. | `dotfiles-portability-stance` pays: a fresh machine may render differently until local.toml is populated; deploy can block on a conflict; `the user who switched a setting in the tool UI` pays: the switch is lost if reverse sync does not cover the key |
| [`dotfiles-explicit-composition-stance`](../dotfiles-explicit-composition-stance/SKILL.md) | explicit-vs-friction | Package selection, coupling, and mappings stay explicit and readable. | `dotfiles-low-friction-stance` pays: every new coupling or mapping is a visible edit; a variable cannot pull in a package |
| [`dotfiles-low-friction-stance`](../dotfiles-low-friction-stance/SKILL.md) | explicit-vs-friction | One package selection deploys a whole environment with few decisions. | `the reader debugging a deployed file` pays: cannot tell which base package supplied a file; a grouping package hides the source |
| [`dotfiles-enterprise-isolation-stance`](../dotfiles-enterprise-isolation-stance/SKILL.md) | isolation-vs-sharing | Enterprise credentials and trust settings never leak to a non-enterprise machine. | `dotfiles-shared-default-stance` pays: an enterprise machine needs separate conditional directories and variables; `the non-enterprise user` pays: carries gating logic and must prove nothing deploys |
| [`dotfiles-shared-default-stance`](../dotfiles-shared-default-stance/SKILL.md) | isolation-vs-sharing | One tracked config serves every machine class, including WSL and Windows. | `dotfiles-enterprise-isolation-stance` pays: a non-enterprise machine carries the gating logic and must prove it deploys nothing |

## Oppositions

| Axis | Pair | Contended resource |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `portability-vs-live-state` | `dotfiles-portability-stance` vs `dotfiles-live-state-stance` | whether the repo or the live tool state is the source of truth for a rendered value |
| `explicit-vs-friction` | `dotfiles-explicit-composition-stance` vs `dotfiles-low-friction-stance` | how many places a maintainer edits to add or change one deployed file |
| `isolation-vs-sharing` | `dotfiles-enterprise-isolation-stance` vs `dotfiles-shared-default-stance` | how many tracked variants one logical config needs |

## Unrepresented stakes

| Id | Stake | Where it appears | Why no stance holds it |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `U-template-readability` | template readability | docs/maintenance/live-state.md#match-the-tools-serialization | no stance: every serializer conflict has been decided for fidelity; the cost is recorded as a sacrifice, not argued as a competing objective |
| `U-unattended-deploy` | unattended deploy | docs/maintenance/deploy.md#deploy-workflow | no stance: safety gates always win; a conflict is surfaced to the user instead of auto-resolved |
| `U-doc-locality` | doc locality | AGENTS.md#documentation-ownership | no stance: a shared target must not receive a package README; the cost is paid by the maintainer who must edit the root doc |

## Decisions

| Id | Kind | Summary | Status | Owner document | Reopen when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `D1-reverse-sync` | sacrifice | Reverse-sync tool-written values into local.toml instead of forcing the template over them. | implemented | docs/maintenance/live-state.md#when-to-reverse-sync | a tool stops rewriting its config, or a new agent config has no stable serializer |
| `D2-serializer-fidelity` | sacrifice | Render the tool's bytes: key order, indentation, omitempty, sorted maps; reverse-sync the values. | implemented | docs/maintenance/live-state.md#match-the-tools-serialization | a tool exposes a stable writer or formatter that makes both fidelity and readability achievable |
| `D3-conditional-deploy` | joint | Put conditional config in a <package>-<condition> source directory and gate its mapping; use #if only when the target has no drop-in. |  | docs/maintenance/config.md#conditional-configuration | a target tool stops reading the drop-in or include location |
| `D4-depends-restriction` | sacrifice | Restrict depends to grouping or functional coupling; test package selection with dotter.packages.<name>. | implemented | docs/maintenance/config.md#package-composition | a variable-only coupling becomes necessary and the dependent has no working form without it |
| `D5-enterprise-gating` | sacrifice | Gate every non-default CA, TLS relaxation, and enterprise credential behind enterprise-artifact or the variable that makes it meaningful. | implemented | docs/maintenance/config.md#enterprise-boundary | an enterprise trust setting becomes safe to ship unconditionally |
| `D6-one-mapping-per-root` | sacrifice | Give each target root one mapping; do not split a shared prefix into exact-file mappings. | implemented | docs/maintenance/config.md#files-mapping | a target root needs a different type or if condition that one mapping cannot express |
| `D7-package-readme` | sacrifice | Allow a package README only for an own-target or non-deployed package; document a shared-target package in the root AGENTS.md. | implemented | AGENTS.md#documentation-ownership | a shared-target package gains its own target mapping or stops being deployed |
| `D8-new-tool-serializer` | open | A new agent tool rewrites its config without a stable serializer. |  | docs/maintenance/live-state.md#match-the-tools-serialization | the tool's writer is observed twice with the same bytes |
